messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout finished: inference-api v2.7.1 -> canary (5%). Starting post-deploy mini-synth (10m, sampling=100%). probe-id=synth-mini-rpm-1

maria: grabbing grafana links, seeing spike in synthetic RPM and p95 on canary nodes: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/abc123/synth-mini (charts pinned) :warning:

sam: confirmed - synthetic client spawned additional workers after the SDK bump, looks like duplicate sampling in some tenants. stacktrace from client logs shows repeated enqueue calls.

leo: infra metrics: canary GPU hosts cpu_util up ~38% -> 62% during spike. A few 429s from inference-proxy around 08:14UTC. No user-facing 5xxs yet.

tess: TL;DR - synth noise is driving canary noise. Proposal: reduce post-deploy mini-synth sampling from 100% -> 5% immediately, pause remainder of rollout and pin traffic. Also add a quick note in release notes about synth sampling change. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: +1 to reduce. We should also mute synth-related alerts for the next 15m so oncall noise is lower.

oncall-bot: Alert suppression: synth-mini-rpm-1 alerts suppressed by @tess for 15m (reason: post-deploy synthetic oversample).

deploy-bot: Executing config change: synth-mini-rpm-1 sampling=100 -> 5% (applied to canary config)

sam: after sampling drop, p95 and RPM for synth probe fell back to baseline in ~30s. still seeing a tiny residual error rate ~0.6% (was 3.8%).

leo: infra: CPU trending down, 429s ceased. No evictions or OOMs observed.

maria: Can we hold the rest of the rollout until we confirm a clean 10m window? Recommend hold + pin to v2.7.0 for routing on non-canary traffic.

tess: Agreed. Holding rollout. I updated the release entry in the internal release notes with a short blurb and linked ticket INF-1234 for the SDK client dedup investigation. Release notes snippet: "Investigating synthetic client sampling regression causing inflated synthetic traffic; rollout paused for verification."

deploy-bot: Rollout hold enacted: global rollout paused, canary remains. Pin applied: default-route locked to v2.7.0 for production.

sam: I'll open a follow-up PR to add idempotency guard in the SDK and add a small synthetic watchdog that avoids multi-enqueue.

leo: plan for next steps: 1) let mini-synth run at 5% for 10m (monitor p95/RPM/429) 2) if stable, ramp to 20% then re-evaluate 3) unpin rollout only after two stable windows.

maria: noted. I'll update the deploy playbook with the sampling knob and add a short how-to in the runbook.

tess: Thanks all. If we hold steady for 10m and no user impact, we'll resume progressive rollout and mark INF-1234 as high priority for the SDK fix. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: synth-mini-rpm-1 suppression expired (15m).

maria: final check - synthetic errors are now under threshold and infra looks stable. leaving hold for another 5m before we think about next ramp.

leo: +1. no further anomalies.

sam: created INF-1234 and linked the PR: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pulls/1427

tess: closing thread for now — rollout still held, will reconvene if anything changes. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
